title: Can synthetic data reproduce real-world findings in epidemiology? A replication study using tree-based generative AI
summary: Code accompanying an epidemiology replication study that uses adversarial random forests (ARF) to synthesize tabular health data from cohorts such as NAKO, BSR-U45 and GFHS, comparing utility, privacy and runtime against other synthesis methods. SDV's TVAESynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer are run in the supplementary runtime and synthesis scripts as comparison baselines against the paper's ARF method.
evidence: Supplement/synthesis/synthesize.py:34-40 defines synthesize_tvae using TVAESynthesizer(metadata).fit/.sample; synthesize_ctgan at line 43 uses CTGANSynthesizer
